Specifically, we propose a unified framework that decouples parameter reasoning from geometric construction through a Plan-Then-Construct paradigm. Our method first produces a structured design plan with explicit metric scale parameters. These parameters are organized into a dictionary and directly referenced during sequence generation via a pointer mechanism, eliminating discretization errors and ensuring dimensionally consistent execution. In addition, we construct a new large-scale dataset with plan-level annotation and introduce three hierarchical geometry accuracy metrics to evaluate parametric fidelity at the vertex, edge, and face levels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Pointer-CAD v2 consistently outperforms existing baselines and achieves substantial improvements in geometric accuracy, enabling reliable CAD generation for precision-critical engineering applications.

</details>


### [96] [MF-UAVPose6D: A Model-Free Monocular 6-DoF Pose Estimation Framework for Fixed-Wing UAVs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29697)
*Juanqin Liu,Leonardo Plotegher,Eloy Roura,Shaoming He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MF-UAVPose6D，一种无需CAD模型和关键点先验的单目6-DoF姿态估计框架，用于固定翼无人机。该方法仅需单张RGB图像和相机内参，通过热力图引导中心定位、透视感知模块、动态拓扑采样和解耦的平移-旋转解码实现姿态估计，并在自建数据集上验证了准确性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于模型或关键点匹配的方法难以应用于缺乏CAD模型和关键点先验的非合作无人机目标，亟需一种无需先验模型的通用姿态估计方法。

Method: 1) 热力图引导的锚点中心定位；2) 透视感知模块(PAM)建模观察射线先验；3) 动态拓扑采样(DTS)补充机翼、机身、尾翼的弱结构线索；4) 解耦的平移-旋转姿态解码机制。

Result: 在自建FW-UAV6DPose数据集上，MF-UAVPose6D实现了无需CAD模型的精确单目6-DoF姿态估计，在远距离旋转估计、深度恢复和联合姿态评估中表现出强鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 提出了一种模型无关的固定翼无人机6-DoF姿态估计框架，有效解决了非合作目标缺乏先验模型的问题，兼顾准确性与效率。

Abstract: For uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs), estimating six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) poses is essential for airspace situational awareness, target tracking, and counter-UAV operations. However, non-cooperative targets usually lack computer-aided design (CAD) models and keypoint priors, making existing model-based or keypoint-matching methods difficult to apply reliably. To address these challenges, this paper proposes MF-UAVPose6D, a model-free monocular 6-DoF pose estimation framework for fixed-wing UAVs. During inference, the method takes only a single red-green-blue (RGB) image and camera intrinsics as input. It first obtains a stable target anchor through heatmap-guided center localization, introduces a Perspective-Aware Module (PAM) to model observation-ray priors, exploits Dynamic Topological Sampling (DTS) to complement weak structural cues from the wings, fuselage, and tail, and adopts a decoupled translation-rotation pose decoding mechanism to estimate the 6-DoF pose. In addition, we construct the FW-UAV6DPose synthetic dataset, which covers fixed-wing UAV observations across diverse distances, viewpoints, and poses. Experimental results show that MF-UAVPose6D achieves accurate and efficient monocular 6-DoF pose estimation without requiring CAD models, and demonstrates strong robustness in long-range rotation estimation, depth recovery, and joint pose evaluation.

</details>


### [97] [Occlusion-Robust Multi-Object Decoupling for Physics-Based Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29303)
*Xin Dong,Wenfeng Deng,Yansong Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需掩码的稀疏视角多物体3D重建方法，结合3D高斯泼溅、SAM2分割场和联合SDS蒸馏实现完整几何重建，并支持基于MPM的物理交互仿真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在多物体稀疏视角和遮挡场景下难以解耦各物体，且依赖人工掩码，限制了真实场景的自动化重建与物理交互。

Method: 以3D高斯泼溅为基础表示，利用SAM2训练的分割场获取粗略实例分区；通过联合SDS过程融合参考视图监督与基于2D/3D扩散先验的新视角合成；引入物体内/物体间相似性等几何感知先验进行正则化。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，无需手动掩码即可生成完整、可直接用于仿真的3D物体，支持真实的动态交互。

Conclusion: 多物体解耦可视为稀疏视角重建问题，利用扩散先验和几何正则化能够有效克服遮挡和视角受限带来的耦合问题，实现无掩码的仿真级重建。

Abstract: We propose a mask-free method for lossless multi-object 3D reconstruction from sparse and occluded real-world views, enabling physically plausible interaction via Material Point Method (MPM) simulation. Our key insight is that object coupling stems from occlusion and limited viewpoints, which we address by formulating multi-object decoupling as a sparse-view reconstruction problem. Using 3D Gaussian Splatting as base representation, we first obtain coarse instance partitions with a SAM2-trained segmentation field. Rather than relying on masks, we reconstruct fragmented geometries by leveraging a joint Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) process, which integrates reference-view supervision with novel-view synthesis guided by 2D and 3D diffusion priors to enforce both texture fidelity and 3D consistency. Furthermore, we incorporate geometry-aware priors such as intra-object and inter-object similarity to regularize geometric reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate that our method produces complete, simulation-ready 3D objects without requiring manual masks, enabling realistic dynamic interactions on both synthetic and real-world datasets.

</details>


### [98] [OP3DSG: Open-Vocabulary Part-Aware 3D Scene Graph Generation for Real-World Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29786)
*Yirum Kim,Ue-Hwan Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OP3DSG是一个开放词汇、部件感知的3D场景图生成框架，通过融合物体-部件检测、3D融合和LLM优化，构建包含物体、交互部件、空间/功能关系等多层次信息的统一图结构，在UniGraph3D基准上达到SOTA效果，并可作为真实机器人任务的感知骨干。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D场景图生成方法以物体为中心，编码的关系信息有限，无法支持需要细粒度理解的现实应用场景。

Method: 1) 物体-部件知识引导的检测 + 部件感知的3D融合，保留小尺寸和交互相关的部件；2) 几何初始化的先验图 + LLM精炼，减少虚假关系预测并提升构建效率。

Result: 在提出的UniGraph3D基准上达到SOTA性能，并在多种真实机器人任务中验证了其作为感知骨干的有效性。

Conclusion: OP3DSG通过将部件级细粒度信息引入3D场景图，显著提升了场景理解的全面性和实用性，为机器人感知提供了更强的结构化表征。

Abstract: 3D scene graphs (3DSGs) provide a compact and structured abstraction of 3D environments. Although advances in foundation models have enabled open-vocabulary 3DSG generation, existing approaches remain object-centric and encode limited relational information -- restricting their applicability in real-world scenarios that require fine-grained understanding. We propose OP3DSG, an open-vocabulary part-aware 3DSG generation framework that constructs unified graphs that jointly model objects, interactive parts, spatial relations, functional relations, and affordances. OP3DSG integrates object-part knowledge-guided detection with part-aware 3D fusion to preserve small and interaction-relevant components, and employs a geometry-initialized prior graph with LLM-based refinement to reduce spurious relational predictions while enabling efficient graph construction. To systematically evaluate unified 3D scene graph construction, we introduce UniGraph3D, a benchmark designed for part-aware perception and multi-level relational reasoning. Experimental results show that OP3DSG achieves state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates its effectiveness as a perception backbone in diverse real-world robotics tasks.

</details>


### [99] [MirrorPPR: Exemplar-Based Portrait Photo Retouching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29308)
*Zhihong Liu,Zheng Li,Jiachun Jin,Siqi Kou,Yitao Jian,Fengpei Yu,Zhijie Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MirrorPPR框架，用于示例驱动的肖像照片结构修图。通过修图操作提取器、LoRA模块注入扩散Transformer，并构建了4700万规模的MirrorPPR47M数据集，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本引导图像编辑在结构肖像修图（如面部特征、身体比例调整）中表现有限，文本难以描述细微变化。而现有示例驱动方法主要处理显著视觉变换，无法应对结构修图中极其精细、局部的修改。

Method: 提出MirrorPPR框架，包含：(1) 修图操作提取器(Retouching Operation Extractor)捕捉示例对的细微差异；(2) 通过连接器和LoRA模块将提取的表示注入预训练扩散Transformer (DiT)；(3) 数据自增强范式保证跨身份训练对的操作严格对齐；(4) 构建4700万规模MirrorPPR47M数据集，分为模拟和专业子集，支持渐进式课程学习。

Result: 实验表明MirrorPPR在修图质量和身份保持方面显著优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: MirrorPPR成功实现了示例驱动的肖像结构修图，通过精细操作提取与注入、大规模数据集和课程学习，解决了跨身份修图操作迁移的挑战。

Abstract: While text-guided image editing has made remarkable progress, it remains limited in structural portrait retouching. Textual descriptions struggle to convey fine-grained changes to facial features and body proportions. To address this gap, we introduce Exemplar-Based Portrait Photo Retouching, where the model is given an exemplar pair and tasked with inferring and applying the same retouching operations to a new query image. Existing exemplar-based editing methods primarily focus on tasks with pronounced visual transformations. In contrast, structural portrait retouching involves extremely delicate and localized modifications, making accurate extraction and transfer of these edits challenging. To tackle this, we propose MirrorPPR, a novel framework designed to capture and transfer subtle structural retouching operations. Our method uses a Retouching Operation Extractor to capture the subtle differences from the exemplar pair. The extracted representations are then injected into a pre-trained Diffusion Transformer (DiT) through a connector and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) modules. Furthermore, constructing perfectly aligned cross-identity training pairs is severely hindered by operation misalignment. To overcome this, we propose an advanced data self-augmentation paradigm that ensures strictly aligned retouching operations. To alleviate data scarcity and support this novel task, we introduce MirrorPPR47M, a large-scale dataset with over 47 million retouched pairs. By structuring the dataset into simulated and professional subsets, we enable progressive curriculum learning to smoothly optimize the network. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MirrorPPR significantly outperforms existing baselines in both retouching quality and identity preservation. The project page is available at https://sjtu-deng-lab.github.io/MirrorPPR.

</details>


### [100] [CylindTrack: Depth-Aware Cylindrical Motion Modeling for Panoramic Multi-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30097)
*Buyin Deng,Kai Luo,Lingxin Huang,Xinqi Liu,Fei Cheng,Hang Zheng,Liming Yin,Kailun Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CylindTrack是一个面向全景多目标跟踪的深度感知圆柱跟踪框架，通过深度-时间轨迹建模、球面时空一致性学习和拓扑感知圆柱运动模型，解决全景视频中周期性图像域、深度不可靠和边界不连续等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景相机在具身感知中具有360°视野优势，但全景MOT并非透视图MOT的简单扩展：等距柱状全景视频的水平图像域是周期的而非欧几里得的，破坏了平面运动假设并使IoU关联在0°/360°边界处不可靠；同时大视野场景包含更多目标、更强尺度变化和更频繁交互，使得在线关联对帧级深度线索高度敏感。

Method: 1) 深度-时间轨迹建模（DTM）：将实例深度从孤立的帧级线索提升为时域滤波后的轨迹级状态；2) 球面时空一致性学习（SSTC）：结合时域混合器与球面几何感知注意力，增强深度表征的时序一致性和全景几何对齐；3) 拓扑感知圆柱运动模型（TCMM）：将水平运动提升到连续角状态空间，在周期全景域中进行边界一致的运动预测与关联。

Result: CylindTrack改善了挑战性全景场景中的身份保持和轨迹连续性。

Conclusion: 通过联合建模轨迹级深度一致性和全景拓扑结构，CylindTrack有效解决了全景MOT中的核心难题。

Abstract: Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) is a core capability for embodied perception, and panoramic cameras are attractive for embodied systems because their 360° field of view reduces blind spots and keeps surrounding targets observable for longer durations. However, panoramic MOT is not a straightforward extension of perspective MOT. In equirectangular panoramic videos, the horizontal image domain is periodic rather than Euclidean, which breaks planar motion assumptions and makes IoU-based association unreliable near the 0°/360° seam. Meanwhile, large-FoV scenes often contain more objects, stronger scale variation, and more frequent interactions, making online association particularly sensitive to unstable frame-wise depth cues. To address these issues, we propose CylindTrack, a depth-aware cylindrical tracking-by-detection framework for panoramic MOT. CylindTrack first introduces Depth-Temporal Trajectory Modeling (DTM), which promotes instance depth from an isolated frame-wise cue to a temporally filtered trajectory-level state. To improve the reliability of depth observations, we further develop Spherical Spatio-Temporal Consistency Learning (SSTC), which combines a Temporal Mixer and Spherical Geometry-aware Attention to enhance temporal coherence and panoramic geometric alignment in depth-aware representations. Finally, we design a Topology-Aware Cylindrical Motion Model (TCMM) that lifts horizontal motion into a continuous angular state space and performs seam-consistent motion prediction and association in the periodic panoramic domain. By jointly modeling trajectory-level depth consistency and panoramic topology, CylindTrack improves identity preservation and trajectory continuity in challenging panoramic scenes. The source code will be released at https://github.com/warriordby/CylindTrack.

</details>


### [101] [D$^{2}$R$^{2}$OSR: Degradation-Disentangled Representation for Real-World Omnidirectional Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29314)
*Hongyu An,Xinfeng Zhang,Xu Fan,Shijie Zhao,Li Zhang,Ruiqin Xiong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出D²R²OSR，一种面向真实世界全景图像超分辨率的退化解耦表示框架，通过显式建模鱼眼成像和ERP投影引起的退化，结合视角投影表示与退化专用模块，实现了高质量的全景超分辨率重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有真实超分方法无法处理全景图像中鱼眼捕获和ERP投影带来的复杂退化（如混叠和投影失真），导致低分辨率ODI难以呈现精细的360°细节。

Method: 提出D²R²OSR框架，包含：(1) 视角投影表示（PPR）与ERP分支并行，捕获视角感知特征；(2) 退化专用模块（DSM），联合建模ERP几何失真和PPR真实退化。

Result: 达到SOTA性能，生成视觉上高质量、高保真的全景超分辨率结果，同时计算效率适合低资源部署。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模全景图像特有的双重退化来源（鱼眼成像+ERP投影），并引入视角中心的人眼感知先验，有效提升了真实场景下全景图像超分辨率的质量。

Abstract: With the growing demand for immersive visual experiences, high-quality omnidirectional images (ODIs) have become increasingly important. However, limitations in imaging devices and transmission bandwidth often lead to low-resolution ODIs, hindering the rendering of fine-grained 360° details, especially in the presence of real-world degradations and geometric distortions. Existing real-world super-resolution (Real-SR) methods are inadequate for ODIs, as their degradation models fail to account for the complex imaging pipeline involving fisheye capture and Equirectangular Projection (ERP), introducing severe aliasing and projection-specific distortions. To address these challenges, we propose D$^{2}$R$^{2}$OSR, a Degradation-Disentangled Representation framework for Real-world Omnidirectional image Super-Resolution. D$^{2}$R$^{2}$OSR explicitly models degradations arising from both fisheye imaging and ERP projection, guided by two key insights: (1) projection priors play a critical role in shaping real-world degradations, and (2) human perception in immersive environments is inherently viewpoint-centric. Accordingly, we introduce a Perspective Projection Representation (PPR) operating alongside the ERP branch to capture viewpoint-aware features, together with a Degradation-Specific Module (DSM) that jointly models ERP-induced geometric distortions and PPR-specific real-world degradations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that D$^{2}$R$^{2}$OSR achieves state-of-the-art performance and produces visually compelling, high-fidelity omnidirectional Real-SR results while maintaining favorable computational efficiency for low-resource deployment.

</details>


### [102] [PS-MOT: Cultivating Instance Awareness from Point Seeds for Multi-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30476)
*Kai Luo,Fei Teng,Mengfei Duan,Wanjun Jia,Xu Wang,Hao Shi,Kunyu Peng,Zhiyong Li,Kailun Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PS-Track，一种点监督多目标跟踪方法，通过数据层（TFP）、模型层（PEWA）和损失层（UGL）的三级流水线，将点标注转换为实例级跟踪，在多个基准上达到新的最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统边界框监督成本高昂，点监督是一种更经济的替代方案，但面临空间模糊和身份漂移的问题。本文旨在解决这些挑战，提供一种可行且有效的点监督跟踪方案。

Method: 提出PS-Track层级流水线：1) 数据层：TFP利用负空间线索和运动先验将点进化为时间一致的伪标签；2) 模型层：PEWA模块利用语义相关性激活高频成分"幻觉"出物体边界；3) 损失层：UGL将伪标签建模为概率分布，动态校准监督强度。

Result: 在DanceTrack、EmboTrack、SportsMOT和JRDB等多个数据集上验证了PS-Track的有效性，建立了点监督跟踪的新最佳性能。

Conclusion: PS-Track提供了一种可行且有效的点监督替代方案，在不同跟踪场景中均表现出色，可作为传统边界框监督的成本效益替代。

Abstract: We introduce Point-supervised Multi-Object Tracking (PS-MOT) as a cost-effective alternative to traditional bounding box supervision, shifting the focus from spatial fitting to topological center-driven representation. However, PS-MOT faces challenges, e.g., spatial ambiguity and identity drift due to the lack of explicit geometric structure and scale constraints. To address these, we propose PS-Track, a hierarchical pipeline transitioning from points to instances across data, model, and loss levels. At the data level, we introduce Temporal-Feedback Prompting (TFP) to evolve points into temporally consistent pseudo-labels using negative spatial cues and motion priors. At the model level, we design the Point-Excited Wavelet Attention (PEWA) module, which leverages semantic correlations to activate high-frequency components, ``hallucinating'' object boundaries. At the loss level, Uncertainty-Guided Gaussian Learning (UGL) models pseudo-labels as probabilistic distributions, dynamically calibrating supervision intensity. Experiments on DanceTrack, EmboTrack, SportsMOT, and JRDB demonstrate that PS-Track provides a feasible and effective point-supervised alternative across diverse tracking scenarios, establishing a new state-of-the-art for point-supervised tracking. The source code is available at https://github.com/xifen523/PS-MOT.

</details>


### [103] [FDM-MFVT: Few-step Sampling Diffusion Model for Mask-Free Virtual Try-On](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29319)
*Jiaxin Liu,Xiaoye Liang,Lai Jiang,Mai Xu,Jun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FDM-MFVT，一种少步扩散模型用于无掩模虚拟试衣，通过OANO模块（6步生成高保真图像）和IDT模块（指令驱动），并构建了3万对的MFVT无掩模数据集，在更少推理步骤下取得优越效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的虚拟试衣方法需要大量采样步骤，依赖掩模和昂贵的辅助网络，且缺乏大规模无掩模配对数据集，限制了无掩模虚拟试衣的发展。

Method: 提出FDM-MFVT框架，包含两个核心模块：1) OANO（Outfit-aware Noise Optimization Module），利用输入图像初始化噪声对齐空间，仅需6步即可生成高保真试衣图像；2) IDT（Instruction-driven Try-on Module），通过虚拟试衣提示和高效适应模块，仅从服装和人物图像生成高质量结果。同时构建了30,000对的MFVT无掩模数据集。

Result: FDM-MFVT在6步内生成的图像质量优于现有方法30步的结果，在定量和定性指标上均超越了基于掩模和无掩模的基线方法。

Conclusion: 提出的少步扩散模型有效解决了无掩模虚拟试衣的效率和数据限制问题，为实际应用提供了更高效灵活的方案。

Abstract: Image-based Virtual Try-On (IVTON) has greatly advanced through diffusion models, yet existing methods require many sampling steps and depend on masks with costly auxiliary networks. In addition, the absence of large-scale mask-free paired datasets further limits the development of mask-free IVTON. We propose FDM-MFVT, a few-step diffusion model for mask-free IVTON, integrating an Outfit-aware Noise Optimization Module (OANO) and an Instruction-driven Try-on Module (IDT) to enhance efficiency and flexibility.The OANO module initializes the alignment space with noise using the input image and only needs 6 steps to generate a higher-fidelity try-on image compared to 30 steps.The IDT module uses virtual try-on prompts and efficient adaptation to generate high-quality results from garment and person images alone. We further introduce MFVT, a 30,000-pair mask-free IVTON dataset. Experiments show that FDM-MFVT achieves superior quantitative and qualitative results with fewer inference steps than mask-based and mask-free baseline methods.

</details>


### [104] [RAGA: Real Time Ray Traced Gaussian Shadow Casting for 3DGS Avatar-Scene Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29329)
*Aymen Mir,Riza Alp Guler,Jian Wang,Peter Wonka,Bing Zhou,Gerard Pons-Moll*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RAGA是一种基于光线追踪的高斯阴影投射方法，通过精确的射线-高斯线积分在3DGS空间中实现物理可信的阴影计算，无需网格重建，支持单/多角色及物体交互场景，速度约50 FPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS虚拟角色动画缺乏物理可信的阴影投射，传统方法依赖网格重建或二值碰撞检测，难以处理动态变形场景中的阴影一致性和时间稳定性。

Method: 提出基于射线-高斯线积分的阴影计算公式，对每个遮挡高斯计算沿阴影射线的透射率积分并归一化；引入虚拟角色代理表示以减少服装变形带来的时间抖动；基于CUDA和OptiX实现高效光线追踪。

Result: 在单角色、多角色及角色-物体交互场景中，相比现有方法显著提升了阴影真实感、时间稳定性和场景一致性，推理速度约50 FPS。

Conclusion: RAGA无需网格即可在纯高斯空间中实现高质量动态阴影，为3DGS虚拟角色动画和场景交互提供了实用的阴影渲染方案。

Abstract: We study the problem of physically plausible shadow casting when animating 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) avatars, either individually or in multi-avatar and object-interaction scenarios, within existing 3DGS scenes. In contrast to prior methods that rely on binary hit tests and mesh-based shadow casters, our method performs shadow computation entirely in Gaussian space, without requiring any mesh reconstruction. We introduce RAGA, a Ray-Traced Gaussian Shadow Casting formulation based on exact ray-Gaussian line integrals. For each occluding Gaussian, we integrate the opacity profile along the shadow ray and normalize by the theoretical maximum integral, producing a weight that captures how the ray traverses the occluder rather than merely whether an intersection occurred. To reduce temporal variance from clothing deformations in animated avatars, we further introduce an avatar proxy representation that stabilizes shadow casting while preserving visual fidelity. We implement RAGA using custom CUDA kernels integrated with the NVIDIA OptiX framework; as such, our shadow tracer runs at rates of about 50 FPS. We evaluate on single-avatar, multi-avatar, and avatar-object interaction scenarios across multiple datasets, demonstrating substantially improved shadow realism, temporal stability, and scene coherence. Our project page is available at https://miraymen.github.io/raga/.

</details>


### [105] [HiReFF: High-Resolution Feedforward Human Reconstruction from Uncalibrated Sparse-View Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29333)
*Yiming Jiang,Hanzhang Tu,Wenfeng Song,Siyou Lin,Liang An,Shuai Li,Aimin Hao,Yebin Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HiReFF提出了一种前馈式方法，能够从非标定的稀疏视角视频（四视角，相隔90°）中实现2K分辨率的360°人体视频重建，通过尺度同步相机标定、高斯级前景掩膜和高分辨率侧调谐技术，在保持计算效率的同时显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的人体重建方法要么依赖逐场景优化或标定相机，要么只能生成低分辨率（0.5K）的单帧合成，无法满足高分辨率、时间一致的流媒体需求。因此需要一种从非标定稀疏视角视频中进行高分辨率、高效且时序一致的360°人体视频重建方法。

Method: 1）Scale-synchronized Camera Calibration：解决多视角监督中的尺度模糊问题；2）Gaussian-wise Foreground Masking：通过调制高斯参数重建干净的前景；3）High-resolution Side-tuning：将高斯头部补充特征，保持主干在0.5K计算，实现2K渲染，降低计算开销。

Result: HiReFF在高分辨率流媒体体积视频重建任务中显著优于现有方法，实现了2K分辨率的360°人体视频重建。

Conclusion: HiReFF通过分解任务为前景3D高斯重建和高分辨率高效合成，成功实现了从非标定稀疏视角视频到2K分辨率360°人体视频的高效重建，为全息通信和AR/VR应用提供了可行的技术方案。

Abstract: Uncalibrated volumetric video streaming for human reconstruction is essential for holographic communication and AR/VR, yet remains challenging due to the need for temporal consistency and computational efficiency from sparse-view inputs. Existing methods rely on per-scene optimization or calibrated cameras, while recent feed-forward models are limited to low-resolution (0.5K) single-frame synthesis. We present HiReFF, a feed-forward method for 2K-resolution 360° human video reconstruction from uncalibrated sparse-view videos. Our framework decomposes the problem into two key tasks: foreground 3D Gaussian reconstruction from sparse-view videos (four views separated by 90°) and computationally efficient high-resolution synthesis. To enable the former, we propose Scale-synchronized Camera Calibration to resolve scale ambiguity for multi-view supervision, and Gaussian-wise Foreground Masking to reconstruct clean foregrounds by modulating Gaussian parameters. For efficient high-resolution synthesis, our High-resolution Side-tuning achieves 2K rendering by augmenting the Gaussian head with supplementary features while keeping the backbone at 0.5K, drastically reducing computational overhead. Experiments demonstrate that HiReFF significantly outperforms existing methods in high-resolution streaming volumetric video reconstruction. https://iridescentjiang.github.io/HiReFF

</details>


### [106] [Multi-scale Object-Aware Gaze Estimation via Geometric Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29334)
*Jiajie Mi,Xinyu Liu,Mengke Song,Chenglizhao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于物体语义的两阶段视线目标估计框架，将任务从像素级回归重构为层次化推理过程，在四个基准数据集上取得领先性能（AUC最高0.987），且参数量仅7.1M。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将视线目标估计建模为全局特征到热力图的直接映射（像素级回归），未能显式表示被注视的物体作为独立实体，导致在复杂场景中难以产生稳定且语义一致的预测。

Method: 两阶段框架：1）特征编码阶段引入物体级表示，将图像特征与离散语义实体对齐；2）细粒度定位阶段采用多尺度特征融合，并结合头部姿态和视线方向施加几何约束，进行物体级判别。

Result: 在GazeFollow、VideoAttentionTarget、ChildPlay、GOO-Real上分别达到AUC 0.961、0.948、0.987、0.977，参数量仅7.1M。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模物体语义实体，将视线目标估计转化为层次化推理过程，显著提升了预测的语义一致性和稳定性，同时保持了轻量化模型设计。

Abstract: Gaze target estimation aims to predict the semantic object an observer fixates upon within an image, a task deeply rooted in the object-oriented nature of human gaze. Observers tend to select a specific semantic entity as the attentional target, rather than responding randomly across arbitrary regions of the image. However, existing methods typically model this task as a direct mapping from global features to gaze heatmaps, essentially treating it as a pixel-level regression problem. This approach fails to explicitly represent the gazed object as a distinct entity, making it difficult to produce stable and semantically consistent predictions in complex scenes. To address this, we propose a two-stage gaze estimation framework guided by object semantics, reformulating gaze target estimation as a hierarchical reasoning process. Our method incorporates object-level representations during feature encoding to align image features with discrete semantic entities, then introduces multi-scale feature fusion and geometric constraints from head pose and gaze direction for fine-grained localization and object-level discrimination. Extensive experiments on GazeFollow, VideoAttentionTarget, ChildPlay, and GOO-Real demonstrate that our method achieves AUC of 0.961, 0.948, 0.987, and 0.977 respectively, delivering strong performance across all benchmarks while maintaining a compact parameter size of 7.1M.

</details>


### [107] [W4A4 Quantization for Inference on Wan2.2-I2V-A14B](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29337)
*Yidong Chen,Chengyu Shi,Jiahao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合MixQ风格混合精度、SmoothQuant风格逐通道平滑和分块HiF4打包的W4A4量化方案，用于Wan2.2视频生成模型，在VBench指标上相比FP16仅下降2-3.5%，优于原生HiFloat4基线（下降约5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 应对ICME 2026低比特大模型量化挑战赛的子任务：在Wan-AI/Wan2.2模型上实现4比特权重和4比特激活推理，同时尽量保持生成质量。

Method: 1) MixQ风格混合精度：对激活值中的稀疏异常通道保持更高精度；2) SmoothQuant风格逐通道平滑：在校准阶段识别重尾激活通道，通过平滑重新平衡动态范围；3) 分块HiF4打包：对前馈线性层进行分块量化；4) 双分支GEMM：异常列保持高精度，其余通道严格采用W4A4。

Result: 在官方VBench I2V指标上，量化后模型在大多数质量轴上与FP16的差距在2-3.5%以内，运动平滑度甚至有所改善，优于原生HiFloat4基线（相对FP16下降约5%）。

Conclusion: 混合精度异常处理+逐通道平滑+分块打包的组合策略能有效降低W4A4量化对视频生成模型的质量损失，在ICME 2026挑战赛中具有竞争力。

Abstract: We summarize our submission to Sub-Challenge 1: W4A4 Quantization for Inference (HiF4 / MXFP4) of the ICME 2026 Low-Bit-width Large-Model Quantization Challenge. The sub-challenge targets 4-bit weight and 4-bit activation inference on Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B under HiF4 or MXFP4 numerical formats. We adapt two complementary ideas from LLM quantization, MixQ-style mixed precision for sparse activation outliers and SmoothQuant-style per-channel smoothing, together with block-wise HiF4 packing for Wan2.2 feed-forward linear layers. Calibration on representative OpenS2V-5M batches identifies heavy-tailed activation channels; smoothing rebalances dynamic range before W4A4 rounding; and a dual-branch GEMM preserves outlier columns in higher precision while the bulk of channels use strict W4A4. On official VBench I2V metrics, our pipeline stays within 2-3.5 percent of FP16 on most quality axes and improves motion smoothness, outperforming a native HiFloat4 baseline that degrades roughly 5 percent relative to FP16 across all reported scores.

</details>


### [108] [Fast Enough to Act: Spatio-Temporal Visual Token Merging for Low-Latency Robotic VLMs and VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29350)
*Junzhou Chen,Jindong Wang,Gang Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ST-Merge是一种即插即用、无需训练的框架，通过在视觉编码阶段融合冗余token，将VLM/VLA模型的推理速度提升2~8.3倍，同时仅带来1%左右的精度损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型处理高分辨率视频时产生大量视觉token，导致推理延迟极高，严重阻碍机器人实时控制。

Method: 1) 构建3D时空坐标，多队列并行匹配与加权聚合融合帧间冗余token；2) 后融合位置校正机制，动态重估加权质心的旋转位置编码，消除空间偏差。

Result: Qwen2.5-VL上VideoQA任务实现2倍加速，精度仅降1%；π0.5 VLA策略上1024×1024分辨率实现8.3倍加速，成功率与基线持平。

Conclusion: ST-Merge能有效突破视觉token带来的计算瓶颈，兼顾高效推理与高精度空间感知，适用于机器人实时控制场景。

Abstract: Vision-language models and vision-language action models endow the robot with unprecedented capabilities. However, the input of video and high-resolution images yields a massive number of visual tokens, leading to extremely high inference latency and severely hindering the robot's real-time control. To break through this computational bottleneck, we propose ST-Merge, a plug-and-play, training-free framework that efficiently fuses redundant tokens directly during the visual encoding phase. By explicitly constructing 3D spatiotemporal coordinates, it employs a multi-queue parallel matching and weighted aggregation mechanism to achieve efficient and geometrically consistent fusion of redundant tokens across frames. In addition, we introduce a post-merge positional correction mechanism that effectively eliminates spatial deviation caused by merging by dynamically re-evaluating the rotational position code of the weighted centroid of the vision token, thereby ensuring the high-precision spatial awareness required for dexterous operation. In the Video Question Answering task on the mainstream VLM, Qwen2.5-VL, ST-Merge achieves a 2$\times$ inference speedup with only a tiny 1\% loss in precision. When deployed on the $π_{0.5}$ VLA policy, ST-Merge achieves an 8.3$\times$ speedup at 1024 $\times$ 1024 resolution and matches the baseline success rate at this high-resolution setting. At lower resolutions, it introduces a small drop in accuracy.

</details>


### [109] [Dynamic Parsing and Updating Natural Language Specification using VLMs for Robust Vision-Language Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29357)
*Xiao Wang,Liye Jin,Dan Xu,Yuehang Li,Lan Chen,Yaowei Wang,Yonghong Tian,Jin Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于语言依赖解析机制的视觉-语言跟踪方法，通过精确提炼目标对象、语义概念和背景上下文等核心跟踪主成分，结合Qwen-VL预训练模型进行组件感知的自适应文本描述更新，有效解决了现有方法中的错误目标更新、背景干扰和幻觉问题，在多个基准测试上取得了一致且优越的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言跟踪方法依赖序列模型或大语言模型直接生成文本描述，存在错误目标更新、背景过度干扰和幻觉伪影等固有缺陷，导致语义与视觉特征不匹配问题未能有效解决。

Method: 提出语言依赖解析机制，精确提炼目标对象、语义概念和背景上下文三大核心跟踪主成分；利用Qwen-VL预训练视觉-语言模型的跨模态理解能力，实现组件感知的自适应文本描述更新。

Result: 在TNL2K、LaSOT、TNLLT、OTB-LANG等多个大规模视觉-语言跟踪基准上取得了一致且优越的跟踪性能。

Conclusion: 通过语言依赖解析和组件感知自适应更新，有效克服了现有方法的关键缺陷，为视觉-语言跟踪提供了新的有效范式。

Abstract: Vision-language tracking guided by natural language specifications leverages high-level semantic cues of target objects to substantially boost tracking accuracy and robustness. Existing studies have verified that adaptively optimizing textual descriptions throughout the tracking process can effectively mitigate the semantic-visual mismatch induced by dynamic variations in target appearance, position, and other inherent attributes. Nevertheless, mainstream methods that directly generate textual information via sequence models or large language models inevitably suffer from inherent defects, including erroneous target updating, excessive background distraction, and pervasive hallucination artifacts. To address the aforementioned limitations, this paper proposes a novel language dependency parsing mechanism to precisely distill core tracking principal components, encompassing target objects, semantic concepts, and background contextual information. On this basis, we perform component-aware adaptive textual description updates by exploiting the powerful cross-modal understanding capability of the pre-trained vision-language model Qwen-VL. By integrating the proposed elaborately designed modules into the baseline framework, our method achieves consistent and superior tracking performance on multiple large-scale vision-language tracking benchmarks, including TNL2K, LaSOT, TNLLT, and OTB-LANG. The source code and pre-trained models will be released at https://github.com/Event-AHU/Open_VLTrack.

</details>


### [110] [SAFE-DiT: Semantics-Aware Fast-path Execution for High-Resolution Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29360)
*Xuanhua Yin,Yuxuan Jia,Chuanzhi Xu,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAFE-DiT 是一种无需训练的高分辨率扩散Transformer推理加速框架，通过识别并消除冗余的空间自注意力掩码（称为Mask-Induced Dispatch Tax, MIDT），实现最高5.09倍端到端加速和大幅降低显存占用，且保持视觉质量非劣性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率DiT推理存在大量空间冗余，现有的空间自适应实现通过注意力掩码编码区域计算，但这会将SDPA操作移出FlashAttention的快速路径，造成严重的系统瓶颈（MIDT）。作者希望在不牺牲生成质量的前提下消除这一瓶颈。

Method: 提出SAFE-DiT框架：(1) 精确去除仅引入行级常数偏移的注意力掩码（如图像自注意力掩码）；(2) 保留语义相关掩码（如文本填充掩码）；(3) 通过提示词条件化的令牌分区、选择性状态更新+全局上下文、以及周期性上下文刷新来实现空间自适应。加速版本为SAFE-Core，另提供敏感度加权CFG版本SAFE-DiT+SW。

Result: 冗余掩码使长序列注意力比无掩码路径慢4.1-5.8倍。在Lumina-Next上，SAFE-DiT在1024²分辨率下实现2.69倍加速，2560²下实现5.09倍加速；峰值显存从94.1GB降至27.9GB（2560²）；支持3072²生成（稠密推理会OOM）。消融实验与盲测表明SAFE-Core视觉质量非劣于稠密快速路径基线。

Conclusion: SAFE-DiT有效解决了因掩码导致的FlashAttention加速路径丢失问题，实现了大幅加速和显存节省，且无需训练。SAFE-Core在纯加速模式下保持视觉质量，SAFE-DiT+SW提供了额外提示对齐的折中方案。

Abstract: High-resolution Diffusion Transformer (DiT) inference contains substantial spatial redundancy, but many spatially adaptive implementations encode regional computation as attention masks, which can inadvertently move scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) away from FlashAttention fast paths. We identify this avoidable systems bottleneck as Mask-Induced Dispatch Tax (MIDT) and show that it grows with latent sequence length. We introduce SAFE-DiT, a training-free Semantics-Aware Fast-path Execution framework that separates exact mask elision from approximation-based spatial scheduling. SAFE-DiT removes only provenance-certified image self-attention masks that induce a row-wise constant shift in attention logits, preserves semantics-bearing masks such as text-padding masks, and realizes spatial adaptation through prompt-conditioned token partitioning, selective state updates with global context, and periodic context refresh. We call this acceleration-only configuration SAFE-Core and report sensitivity-weighted classifier-free guidance separately as SAFE-DiT+SW. On the evaluated PyTorch SDPA stack, redundant masks make long-sequence attention $4.1\times$ to $5.8\times$ slower than the mask-free path. On Lumina-Next, SAFE-DiT achieves $2.69\times$ end-to-end acceleration at $1024^2$ resolution and $5.09\times$ at $2560^2$, reduces peak memory at $2560^2$ from 94.1 to 27.9 GB, and enables $3072^2$ generation when dense inference runs out of memory. Paired metrics, component ablations, and a blinded human study support visual non-inferiority of SAFE-Core to the dense fast-path baseline, while SAFE-DiT+SW provides a separate prompt-alignment operating point without reintroducing spatial self-attention masks. Code is available at https://github.com/xuanhuayin/SAFE-DiT.

</details>


### [111] [L2D2-GS: Learning to Densify for Feedforward Dynamic Gaussian Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29374)
*Zetian Song,Chenming Wu,Junnan Liu,Chitian Sun,Liangliang He,Hangjun Ye,Jiaqi Zhang,Siwei Ma,Wen Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出L2D2-GS，一种用于动态城市场景高保真重建的统一框架，通过迭代优化与稠密化策略、自监督稠密化策略和几何正则化机制，在PandaSet和Waymo数据集上实现了最先进的重建保真度和零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS方法依赖昂贵的逐场景优化，难以扩展；而前馈方法在高分辨率下内存开销巨大，且难以一致融合多视图密集观测。本文旨在解决可泛化重建中的可扩展性和多视图融合瓶颈。

Method: 提出一个统一的迭代优化与稠密化框架：1) 自监督稠密化策略，从全局重建增益中导出显式奖励信号指导局部稠密化；2) 几何正则化机制，通过重参数化约束优化流形，防止陷入局部劣质最优解。

Result: 在PandaSet和Waymo数据集上，该方法实现了最先进的重建保真度与强零样本泛化能力，且相比基线方法使用了更少的图元数量。

Conclusion: 本文证明将可泛化重建从一次性回归改造成迭代优化与稠密化过程是有效的，为解决3DGS可扩展性问题提供了新思路。

Abstract: High-fidelity reconstruction of dynamic urban environments is a cornerstone of autonomous driving simulation and large-scale world modeling. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has established a new standard for real-time rendering, its reliance on expensive per-scene optimization limits scalability. Conversely, recent feedforward methods that infer Gaussian parameters offer faster speed but face fundamental bottlenecks: they are memory-prohibitive at high resolutions and struggle to fuse dense multi-view observations consistently. This paper presents L2D2-GS, a unified framework that reformulates generalizable reconstruction not as a one-shot regression, but as a robust iterative process of optimization and densification. To resolve the ambiguity of supervision in primitive generation, we propose a self-supervised densification policy that derives explicit reward signals from global reconstruction gains to guide local densification. Furthermore, we mitigate irreversible early-stage artifacts through a geometric regularization mechanism, utilizing reparameterization to constrain the optimization manifold and prevent convergence to poor local optima. Extensive experiments on the PandaSet and Waymo datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction fidelity and strong zero-shot generalization, while using fewer primitives than competing baselines.

</details>


### [112] [SAD-GS: Learning Reliable 3D Semantic Gaussian Fields via Dynamic Geo-Semantic Anchoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29376)
*Yufei Zhang,Chenlu Zhan,Gaoang Wang,Hongwei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAD-GS通过动态地理语义锚定机制，解决多视图2D监督中语义漂移和边界泄漏问题，实现可靠的开放词汇3D语义高斯场学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放词汇3D语义高斯场学习依赖多视图2D监督，但跨视角的特征差异导致语义身份漂移，追踪掩码传播带来边界泄漏和身份切换，直接优化不可靠的2D目标会导致3D表示吸收多视角矛盾，造成严重误差累积。

Method: 提出语义锚定蒸馏(SAD)将每视角视觉嵌入蒸馏为共识文本锚点，建立视角不变的语义身份；同时设计地理语义反馈循环(GSFL)，利用演化中的3D场主动过滤追踪异常并通过保守三门更新规则细化空间掩码分配。

Result: 在LERF-OVS、3D-OVS和Mip-NeRF360数据集上，SAD-GS在开放词汇定位和语义分割任务中均取得最佳综合性能。

Conclusion: 动态地理语义锚定机制能有效提升3D语义高斯场学习的可靠性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D semantic Gaussian field learning relies on multi-view 2D supervision, whose semantic targets and spatial assignments are often unreliable. Across varying viewpoints, view-dependent features cause semantic identity drift, while propagated tracker masks introduce boundary leakage and identity switches. Directly optimizing against these unreliable 2D targets forces the 3D representation to absorb multi-view contradictions, leading to severe error accumulation. To resolve this limitation, we propose SAD-GS, a framework for learning reliable 3D semantic Gaussian fields via dynamic geo-semantic anchoring. Specifically, Semantic Anchor Distillation (SAD) distills per-view visual embeddings into consensus text anchors to establish a viewpoint-invariant semantic identity. Concurrently, the Geo-Semantic Feedback Loop (GSFL) leverages the evolving 3D field to actively filter tracker anomalies and refine spatial mask assignments via a conservative three-gate update rule. Extensive evaluations on LERF-OVS, 3D-OVS, and Mip-NeRF360 show that SAD-GS consistently achieves the best overall performance in both open-vocabulary localization and semantic segmentation. These comprehensive improvements validate the effectiveness and robustness of dynamic geo-semantic anchoring for reliable 3D semantic Gaussian field learning.

</details>


### [113] [DR-GS: Physically-Based Deformable and Relightable 2D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29379)
*Jiaxin Li,Tong Wu,Yi Wei,Tailin Wu,Li Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DR-GS提出了一种统一的高斯框架，通过显式解耦几何、光照和材质表示，解决了可变形物体的光照烘焙和快照重建限制，实现了物理一致的动态变形、重光照和后期材质编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于高斯泼溅的可变形物体方法存在两个关键问题：(i) 光照被错误地烘焙到纹理中，导致动态变形和光照变化下物理不一致；(ii) 基于快照的重建限制了重建后的材质编辑。

Method: 提出DR-GS（可变形可重光照高斯泼溅）统一框架，整合了基于物理的逆向渲染、重光照和变形感知操作，通过显式解耦几何、光照和材质表示来实现。

Result: 在静态重建、动态变形和重光照任务中均达到领先的视觉质量，能够可靠地保留光泽表面的反射和高光；建立了完全解耦的几何-光照-材质管线。

Conclusion: DR-GS克服了静态快照的限制，解决了变化条件下不真实的外观问题，实现了高质量3D资产创建和全面的后期编辑能力。

Abstract: Gaussian splatting (GS) has garnered significant attention in VR/AR and digital content creation due to its explicit parameterization and efficient rendering capabilities. However, existing GS-based methods for deformable objects face two key limitations: (i) illumination is erroneously baked into textures, causing physically inconsistent responses under dynamic deformations and lighting changes; (ii) snapshot-based reconstruction restricts post-reconstruction material editing. To address these challenges, we propose Deformable and Relightable GS (DR-GS), a unified Gaussian framework that integrates physically-based inverse rendering, relighting, and deformation-aware manipulation. Through explicitly disentangling geometry, illumination, and material representations, DR-GS overcomes the limitations of static snapshots, resolving unrealistic appearance under varying conditions while enabling post-reconstruction parameter editing. Extensive experiments show that DR-GS achieves leading visual quality across static reconstruction, dynamic deformation, and relighting, reliably preserving reflections and specular highlights on glossy surfaces. It further establishes a fully decoupled geometry-illumination-material pipeline, enabling high-quality 3D asset creation and comprehensive post-editing.

</details>


### [114] [NaLA: A 3D Native LLM Layout Agent for High-quality 3D Scene Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29395)
*Cheng Wan,Yongsen Mao,Wenzheng Wu,Yuxuan Xie,Chucheng Xiang,Runze Wang,Xiang Zhang,Zhongyuan Liu,Rushi Dai,Yuan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NaLA是一种原生3D LLM布局智能体，通过直接编码3D资产和场景边界，结合粗到细的位姿预测机制，实现了高质量、高推理效率的3D场景生成，性能优于现有布局智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM布局智能体将3D资产和布局转换为文本描述，导致信息严重丢失（模态差距），生成的布局不合理。NaLA旨在直接以原生3D形式处理信息，减少信息损失。

Method: NaLA提出原生3D LLM布局智能体：1）输入阶段直接编码3D场景边界和3D资产；2）采用粗到细预测机制，先自回归预测离散位姿，再通过连续回归优化；3）在多样化布局数据集上训练。

Result: NaLA在生成质量和推理效率上均优于以往的布局智能体，消融实验验证了各模块的有效性，具备强大的几何感知和布局连贯性。

Conclusion: 原生3D表征和粗到细预测机制能有效弥合文本与3D之间的模态差距，为高质量3D场景生成提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as promising layout agents for 3D scene generation. Existing layout agents still suffer from implausible layout generation because most of them convert 3D assets and 3D layouts into textual descriptions as inputs and outputs, which involves severe information loss due to the modality gap between texts and 3D assets and 3D layouts. We propose NaLA, a native 3D LLM layout Agent for high-quality 3D scene generation by placing 3D assets in the scene. For the inputs, NaLA encodes 3D scene boundaries and 3D assets directly into the LLM, preserving fine-grained geometry and enabling explicit reasoning over relationships like collisions, surface supporting, and containment. To accurately output the positions and orientations of assets, NaLA adopts a coarse-to-fine prediction mechanism that first predicts discrete poses in an autoregressive manner and then refines the discrete poses with a continuous regression. Trained on diverse layout datasets, NaLA attains strong geometric perception and layout coherence. Experiments demonstrate that NaLA outperforms prior layout agents in both generation quality and inference efficiency, with comprehensive ablation studies to verify each component's effectiveness.

</details>


### [115] [Learning to Adaptively Allocate Gaussians for Arbitrary-Scale Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29400)
*Giulio Federico,Giuseppe Amato,Claudio Gennaro,Fabio Carrara,Marco Di Benedetto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出QuADA-GS，一种基于高斯泼溅的自适应任意尺度超分辨率方法，通过神经路由架构动态分配计算资源，实现高效、高质量的连续分辨率图像上采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有任意尺度超分辨率方法存在两个关键问题：(1) 传统模型仅支持固定整数倍缩放，连续分辨率需依赖次优插值；(2) 大多数方法对像素均匀处理，忽视了细节稀疏性带来的计算浪费。高斯泼溅虽具备自适应密化的优势，但将其转化为前馈模型面临挑战——标准GS优化需要高分辨率梯度驱动原始增长，而这在推理时不可用。

Method: QuADA-GS包含三个核心组件：(1) 神经路由架构，评估局部复杂度以分配全局预算，为不同特征指定不同上采样因子，避免冗余计算；(2) 动态密化机制，根据路由分配的上采样因子对特征进行不规则拓扑密化；(3) 层次化指针卷积，实现O(1)邻域查找复杂度的非网格算子，促进特征间的空间通信。

Result: 实验表明，QuADA-GS在任意尺度超分辨率任务上达到最先进性能，同时保持低延迟和较小的内存占用。

Conclusion: 通过将高斯泼溅的自适应密化能力与神经路由的预算分配机制相结合，QuADA-GS成功实现了无需高分辨率梯度监督的前馈式任意尺度超分辨率，验证了非均匀计算资源分配在连续图像表示中的有效性。

Abstract: In computer graphics, visual content is continuously warped, zoomed and resampled. This occurs when engines upscale frames, users zoom into 3D scenes, or foveated VR applies varying scaling. Handling these transformations requires Arbitrary-Scale Super-Resolution (ASR). Traditional models, designed for fixed scales, typically predict at a lower integer scale (e.g., x4) and rely on sub-optimal interpolation for continuous resolutions, compromising quality. Furthermore, most methods process pixels uniformly. Since fine details are sparse, this creates overhead; efficiency dictates concentrating resources only where structural complexity demands it. While implicit models and Gaussian Splatting (GS) enable continuous representation, GS is advantageous due to adaptive densification. However, transitioning GS into a feed-forward model for ASR is non-trivial. Standard GS optimization needs high-resolution gradients to drive primitive growth, which are unavailable during inference. Thus, the network must autonomously predict GS densification from low-resolution inputs. To solve this, we propose QuADA-GS. After encoding inputs into a latent space, a Neural Routing Architecture evaluates local complexity to distribute a global budget, assigning specific upsampling factors to features to avoid redundant processing. Features are dynamically densified based on these factors, forming an irregular topology decoded into 2D Gaussian primitives. To coordinate features before decoding, we introduce Hierarchical Pointer Convolution. This non-grid operator achieves O(1) neighbor lookup complexity, facilitating efficient spatial communication and bypassing dense bottlenecks. Experiments show QuADA-GS achieves state-of-the-art ASR performance, maintaining low latency and a lean memory footprint.

</details>


### [116] [FiRe: Frequency Reparameterization as a Preconditioner for Periodic Implicit Neural Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29414)
*Harinandan Shukla,Rajarshi Verma,Jitin Singla*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FiRe通过为周期性隐式神经表示中的每个神经元分配输入依赖的频率（通过低秩门控路径实现），作为隐式预条件子改善优化条件，加速收敛，在2D图像拟合任务中提升PSNR最高达+1dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有周期性INR（如SIREN、FINER）为所有神经元分配相同的全局频率，当局部信号内容变化时，这种统一的频率分配导致表示效率低下，无法高效利用计算资源。

Method: 提出FiRe（频率重参数化），通过一个独立的低秩门控路径为每个神经元生成有界的、输入依赖的频率，不改变底层激活函数。该门控作为隐式预条件子，通过神经正切核（NTK）改善初始化时的优化条件。

Result: 在2D图像拟合任务中，FiRe在固定计算预算下比参数匹配的基线模型PSNR提升最高达+1dB（短训练预算下），增益随分辨率和训练预算变化，在完全收敛时减弱。

Conclusion: FiRe通过NTK理论预测了性能与分辨率、秩和训练预算的关系，证明了这种频率重参数化策略能有效加速周期性INR的收敛并提高重建质量。

Abstract: Periodic Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) such as SIREN and FINER assign every neuron, the same global frequency, spending the representational budget inefficiently when local signal content varies. We introduce FiRe (Frequency Reparameterization), that accelerates optimization by reparameterizing per-neuron frequency of periodic INRs without changing their underlying activation function. FiRe gives each neuron a bounded, input-dependent frequency via a separate low-rank gating path and is applicable to any periodic activation function. The gate acts as an implicit preconditioner that improves optimization conditioning at initialization via the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK). This better-conditioned initialization makes optimization converge faster, and the high-frequency content of the reconstruction tracks the target more closely at a fixed computational budget. On 2D image fitting, FiRe increases PSNR over a parameter-matched baseline (up to +1 dB at short training budgets), with gains that vary with resolution and diminish at full convergence. We characterize how performance depends on resolution, rank, and training budget, and give an NTK account that predicts these trends.

</details>


### [117] [Tool-Augmented Spatiotemporal Reasoning for Streamlining Video Question Answering Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.10359)
*Sunqi Fan,Jiashuo Cui,Meng-Hao Guo,Shuojin Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个视频工具包（Video Toolkit）和时空推理框架（STAR），通过轻量级工具增强多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的视频时空推理能力，在VideoMME和LongVideoBench上分别提升8.2%和4.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM在VideoQA任务中难以同时建模视频帧内的空间关系和时间演变的因果动态，缺乏有效的时空推理能力。

Method: 1) 构建了一个全面且可扩展的Video Toolkit；2) 提出STAR框架，通过策略性地调度时间和空间工具，逐步定位视频关键区域，避免工具链捷径问题。

Result: STAR框架在GPT-4o基础上，VideoMME提升8.2%，LongVideoBench提升4.6%。

Conclusion: 所提出的Video Toolkit和STAR框架是构建自主智能视频分析助手的重要一步，代码已开源。

Abstract: Video Question Answering (VideoQA) task serves as a critical playground for evaluating whether foundation models can effectively perceive, understand, and reason about dynamic real-world scenarios. However, existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle with simultaneously modeling spatial relationships within video frames and understanding the causal dynamics of temporal evolution on complex and reasoning-intensive VideoQA task. In this work, we equip MLLM with a comprehensive and extensible Video Toolkit, to enhance MLLM's spatiotemporal reasoning capabilities and ensure the harmony between the quantity and diversity of tools. To better control the tool invocation sequence and avoid toolchain shortcut issues, we propose a Spatiotemporal Reasoning Framework (STAR) that strategically schedules temporal and spatial tools, thereby progressively localizing the key area in the video. Our STAR framework enhances GPT-4o using lightweight tools, achieving an 8.2% gain on VideoMME and 4.6% on LongVideoBench. We believe that our proposed Video Toolkit and STAR framework make an important step towards building autonomous and intelligent video analysis assistants. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/fansunqi/VideoTool.

</details>


### [118] [Can Machines Really See Objects in Images? A Study Based on Syntactic Distance and Visual Self-Referential Instances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29416)
*Xingyu Peng,Junran Wu,Yue Hou,Zhongliang Qiao,Jiaheng Liu,Shangzhe Li,Jichang Zhao,Wenjun Wu,Xianglong Liu,Yongxin Tong,Li Dong,Ke Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"句法距离"概念，衡量视觉模型在局部统计线索失效时能否真正识别全局语义。通过构建最大方差二值噪声任务（闭合正方形vs.一个像素翻转），发现ResNet和ViT在图像尺度跨越临界点时准确率急剧下降至随机水平，且更大模型/数据只能延缓崩溃，全局注意力ViT反而更早崩溃，揭示当前架构存在结构性能力边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 质疑当前视觉模型是否真正"看见"物体，还是仅拟合表面统计线索。受维特根斯坦"语言的界限即世界的界限"启发，认为模型识别能力受限于其习得的描述系统（即局部特征表示），因此探究当局部线索无法提供稳定区分依据时，模型是否仍能正确分类。

Method: 提出"句法距离"概念衡量类间可分性：正距离表示存在可用的局部特征，零距离则需要全局语义。构建视觉自指涉任务：最大方差二值噪声图像中，正样本含闭合正方形，负样本含一个边界像素翻转的相同正方形，两类在全局语义不同但句法距离为零。在ResNet和Vision Transformer上进行实验。

Result: 发现一致的相变现象：当图像尺度跨越临界点，准确率骤降至随机猜测水平且无法恢复；更大训练集和模型仅能延缓崩溃，而全局注意力的ViT反而更早达到崩溃点。

Conclusion: 当前视觉架构在全局概念任务上存在结构性能力边界，暗示通用智能可能需要创造新的语言，而非复用现有语言。

Abstract: Can a vision model truly see an object, or does it only fit surface-level visual cues? Following Wittgenstein's view that the limits of language are the limits of the world, we view a model's recognition ability as bounded by the descriptive system it has learned. In current vision models, this system is often realized through learned feature representations that exploit local statistical cues. We therefore ask whether a model can still classify correctly when such local cues provide no stable basis for distinction. We formalize this question with syntactic distance, which measures class separability through the symmetry of the operations mapping one class to the other: positive distance exposes exploitable local features, whereas zero distance requires global semantics rather than local rules. We construct a visual self-referential task in maximum-variance binary noise: positive samples contain a closed square, while negative samples contain an otherwise identical square with one flipped boundary pixel. The two classes differ in global semantics but have zero syntactic distance, making local statistical shortcuts unreliable. Experiments on ResNets and Vision Transformers reveal a consistent phase-transition phenomenon, with accuracy collapsing to random guessing once the image scale crosses a critical point and does not recover within the tested range. Larger training sets and models only delay this collapse, while globally attentive ViTs reach it earlier. These results reveal a structural capability boundary of current architectures on global-concept tasks, suggesting that general intelligence may require creating new language, not reusing an existing one.

</details>


### [119] [Bit-ViP: Leveraging Bit-planes to Preserve Visual Privacy in Images through Obfuscation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29417)
*Vishesh Kumar Tanwar,Ashish Gupta,Sanjay Madria,Sajal K. Das*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于位平面的图像混淆方案Bit-ViP，利用洛伦兹混沌系统和差分隐私生成不可逆噪声，在保护视觉隐私的同时保持图像可用性，在活动识别数据集上验证了其安全性优于现有方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像混淆方案要么易受模型逆向攻击（重建原始图像），要么生成不可训练的混淆图像导致识别准确率下降，亟需一种既能抵御攻击又能保持可用性的隐私保护方案。

Method: 提出Bit-ViP方案：基于位平面的端到端图像混淆函数，创新性地结合洛伦兹混沌系统与差分隐私生成非可逆噪声，使混淆图像难以被重建。

Result: 在UCF101和HMDB51数据集上验证有效性；面对重构攻击、像素频率、信息熵和像素互相关等多维度安全分析，均显著优于现有方案。

Conclusion: Bit-ViP在安全性与可用性之间取得了良好平衡，为图像识别任务中的视觉隐私保护提供了一种有效且鲁棒的方案。

Abstract: The unprecedented growth of computer vision applications, such as surveillance systems and social media, raises security and visual privacy concerns, especially when data is stored on cloud servers. Image obfuscation offers a way to preserve visual privacy while maintaining an adequate level of usability; thus, it has been a topic of great interest in recent years. However, prior obfuscation schemes are either vulnerable to malicious attacks, such as model inversion to reconstruct original images from obfuscated images, or generate non-trainable obfuscated images, making them unusable for achieving reasonable accuracy. This paper proposes a novel bit-plane-based image obfuscation scheme, {\em Bit-ViP}, to preserve visual privacy for image-based recognition tasks. The Bit-ViP scheme produces secure, usable images by incorporating an innovative end-to-end obfuscation function. While doing so, the obfuscated image would contain non-invertible noise (generated by Lorenz's chaotic system and differential privacy), making it hard for an adversary to reconstruct the original image. We conduct extensive experiments on two popular activity recognition datasets, namely UCF101 and HMDB51, to validate the effectiveness of Bit-ViP. In the face of attacks on reconstruction, pixel frequency, information entropy, and pixel inter-correlation, we present a rigorous security analysis demonstrating tangible improvements over existing schemes.

</details>


### [120] [Robust Zero-shot Anomaly Detection under Limited Auxiliary Anomaly Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29428)
*Guanyu Lu,Fang Zhou,Cheqing Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DIVE是一种零样本异常检测方法，通过浅层和深层文本嵌入注入策略及解耦机制，在辅助异常先验有限的情况下显著提升检测性能，在12个数据集上优于现有基线方法最高达47%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本异常检测模型假设辅助数据包含丰富的异常多样性，但忽略了真实目标领域中更复杂且不可预测的变化；本文首次研究辅助异常先验有限的情况，解决由此导致的性能大幅下降问题。

Method: 提出DIVE框架：(1) 在视觉编码过程中采用浅层和深层文本嵌入注入策略，学习跨辅助训练域和目标域的通用异常概念；(2) 提出解耦机制，解决与物体语义纠缠的视觉嵌入与与物体无关的文本提示之间的次优对齐问题。

Result: 在辅助数据异常模式有限的设置下，DIVE在12个数据集上平均性能超越SOTA基线：分类指标提升16.2%和28.5%，分割指标提升23.4%、24.1%和47.0%；且在辅助数据异常多样性充足时仍保持极具竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: DIVE有效解决了辅助异常先验有限场景下的零样本异常检测性能退化问题，同时在不同异常多样性条件下均表现优异，具有广泛的适用性。

Abstract: Zero-shot anomaly detection aims to identify defects in arbitrary novel domains; however, existing models assume that the auxiliary data contains a rich diversity of anomalies, neglecting the far more complex and unpredictable variations in real-world target domains. This study introduces DIVE, the first approach to investigate the scenario of limited auxiliary anomaly priors and resolve the resulting substantial performance degradation. Through a shallow-and-deep text embedding injection strategy during visual encoding, DIVE learns to abstract generic anomaly concepts shared across the auxiliary training domain and diverse target domains. Moreover, we propose a disentanglement mechanism to tackle the suboptimal alignment between visual embeddings entangled with object semantics and object-agnostic textual prompts. Experiments demonstrate that, under the setting of limited anomaly patterns in auxiliary data, DIVE outperforms SOTA baselines by up to 16.2% and 28.5% on two classification metrics, and 23.4%, 24.1%, and 47.0% on three segmentation metrics, in terms of average performance across twelve datasets. Furthermore, it maintains highly competitive performance when auxiliary data exhibits sufficient anomaly diversity.

</details>


### [121] [EvLIR: Learning Illumination Residuals from Ordered Events for Low-Light Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29430)
*Haoxian Zhou,Chuanzhi Xu,Langyi Chen,Pengfei Ye,Haodong Chen,Qiang Qu,Ali Anaissi,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EvLIR利用有序事件流的时间残差信息，通过ConvGRU建模短窗口事件动态，实现低光图像增强，在四个基准测试的11/12指标上达到最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光图像增强具有严重的不适定性，现有事件相机方法将体素通道视为无序或静态特征堆栈，未显式建模窗口内的时间演化，削弱了事件相机的时序优势。

Method: 提出EvLIR框架，包含Temporal Event Residual Module (TERM)，使用轻量级ConvGRU编码短窗口事件动态，将时序状态转换为有界照明校正，为Retinex风格的照明估计提供空间自适应光度引导。

Result: 在SDE和SDSD室内/室外基准上，在12个数据集-指标组合中取得11个最佳结果，平均PSNR 25.63 dB, PSNR* 28.30 dB, SSIM 0.827。

Conclusion: 显式建模事件流的有序时序信息能有效提升低光图像增强质量，验证了事件时序残差建模的价值。

Abstract: Low-light image enhancement is severely ill-posed when the input frame contains missing structure, saturated noise, and weak local contrast. Event cameras provide asynchronous brightness-change observations with high temporal resolution, but prior works often treat voxel channels as an unordered or static feature stack before fusion, rather than explicitly modeling their within-window temporal evolution, weakening the temporal evidence that makes events useful. We propose EvLIR, a temporal-residual enhancement framework that learns illumination residuals from ordered events for low-light image enhancement. Given a low-light frame and its aligned event voxel, EvLIR preserves the ordered temporal bins of the event stream and introduces a Temporal Event Residual Module (TERM) to encode short-window event dynamics with a lightweight ConvGRU. The resulting temporal state is converted into a bounded illumination correction, which provides spatially adaptive photometric guidance for Retinex-style illumination estimation and subsequent reliability-aware image-event restoration. On SDE and SDSD indoor/outdoor benchmarks, EvLIR achieves the best result on eleven of twelve dataset-metric pairs, with average scores of 25.63~dB PSNR, 28.30~dB PSNR*, and 0.827 SSIM across the four benchmarks.

</details>


### [122] [Bridging VideoQA and Video-Guided Agentic Tasks via Generalized Keyframe Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29445)
*Sunqi Fan,Qingle Liu,Runqi Yin,Meng-Hao Guo,Shuojin Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VG-GUIBench基准测试，用于评估MLLM-based GUI代理能否从视频教程中学习并完成交互任务；同时提出TASKER关键帧提取算法，联合考虑任务相关性和场景动态，在VideoQA和视频引导代理任务上均取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准主要评估模型对浅层视觉线索的感知能力，很少检验MLLM能否从视频教程中学习深层知识或程序性技能，并将其泛化到下游长周期智能体任务中。

Method: 1）提出VG-GUIBench基准，评估GUI代理遵循视频教程完成交互任务的能力；2）提出TASKER关键帧提取算法，同时考虑任务相关性（task relevance）和场景动态（scene dynamics）来筛选信息帧。

Result: TASKER在EgoSchema fullset上比最优基线提升2.0%，在NExT-QA数据集上提升1.8%，在VideoQA和视频引导代理任务上均表现优异。

Conclusion: 任务驱动且感知场景的关键帧提取方法对视频理解任务具有重要潜力，模型在VideoQA和视频引导代理任务上的性能均高度依赖于有效的关键帧提取。

Abstract: Video understanding is a fundamental capability for multimodal intelligence, and recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on Video Question Answering (VideoQA) benchmarks. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate whether models can perceive shallow visual cues, while rarely examining whether MLLMs can learn deeper knowledge or procedural skills from video tutorials and generalize them to downstream long-horizon agentic tasks. To address this gap, we introduce VG-GUIBench (Video-Guided GUI Benchmark), a new benchmark designed to evaluate whether MLLM-based GUI agents can follow video tutorials to complete corresponding GUI interactive tasks. Furthermore, we observe that the performance of models on both VideoQA and video-guided agentic tasks critically depends on effective keyframe extraction. Based on this observation, we propose TASKER (Task-driven And Scene-aware Keyframe searchER), a keyframe extraction algorithm that jointly considers task relevance and scene dynamics to identify informative frames. Experimental results demonstrate that TASKER achieves significant performance improvements on both VideoQA and video-guided agentic task benchmarks, outperforming the best baseline by 2.0% on the EgoSchema fullset and 1.8% on the NExT-QA dataset, respectively. These results further highlight the potential of generalized keyframe extraction methods for video understanding tasks. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/VG-GUI-TASKER/VG-GUI-TASKER.

</details>


### [123] [Miti360: A Comprehensive Dataset for Improved Reforestation Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29447)
*Cedric Kiplimo,Samuel Mbatia,Ciira wa Maina,Arthur Sichangi,Dennis Gitundu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了Miti360数据集，包含肯尼亚Kieni森林的高分辨率航拍、地面影像、树木标注和天气数据，填补了非洲林业监测数据的空白。通过微调DeepForest模型，边界框精度提升12%，召回率提升69%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ML森林监测训练数据主要来自北美、欧洲、亚洲和澳大利亚，非洲林业数据严重缺失。为解决地理多样性不足的问题，作者构建了首个面向非洲亚撒哈拉地区的综合性再造林监测数据集。

Method: 在肯尼亚Kieni森林770公顷再造林区域收集数据（2023年3月至2025年2月）。航拍使用DJI Mavic 2 Pro，经Agisoft Metashape拼接、ArcGIS Pro切片；地面数据使用智能手机和定制立体相机。包含正射影像、树木边界框标注、地面单目/立体图像、树木生物物理参数、物种、GPS坐标及历史天气数据。

Result: 成功追踪三年间树木冠层变化，通过Miti360微调DeepForest模型，边界框精度（box precision）提升12%，召回率（box recall）提升69%。

Conclusion: Miti360数据集可用于加速树木普查、物种-区域匹配、基于天气的生长建模、数字孪生框架等ML任务，推动亚撒哈拉地区再造林监测和可持续林业实践。

Abstract: Over the past decade, interest in applying machine learning (ML) to automate forest monitoring has grown significantly. However, existing training datasets are predominantly drawn from North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia, leaving a critical gap in African forestry data. To address this limited geographic diversity, we present Miti360, a comprehensive dataset for reforestation monitoring that comprises high-resolution imagery, ground truth data, and longitudinal weather data. Data collection occurred within a 770-ha reforested section of the Kieni Forest in Kenya between March 2023 and February 2025. Miti360 comprises aerial photos (orthophotos and tiles) with tree bounding box annotations, terrestrial images (single and stereo), and detailed data records including tree biophysical parameters, species, and GPS coordinates, alongside historical weather data. Aerial surveys utilized a DJI Mavic 2 Pro, with imagery stitched via Agisoft Metashape and tiled using ArcGIS Pro, while terrestrial captures used smartphones and custom stereo cameras. Miti360 enables the training of ML systems for tasks such as accelerating tree censuses, matching species to geographical areas, modelling growth based on weather conditions, and developing digital twin frameworks. Models can be trained on Miti360 to address challenges specific to Sub-Saharan Africa, ultimately advancing reforestation monitoring and fostering sustainable forestry practices in underrepresented regions. We demonstrate the utility of this dataset by successfully tracking tree crowns across three years and improving the DeepForest model's box precision and box recall by 12% and 69% respectively through fine-tuning on Miti360.

</details>


### [124] [The Platonic Defense: Backdoor Defense for Self-Supervised Encoders in the Era of Large Scale Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29451)
*Tuo Chen,Minjing Dong,Benlei Cui,Jian Liu,Jie Gui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于柏拉图表示假说的黑盒测试时防御方法（Platonic Representation Defense），利用多个独立预训练编码器的表示一致性，通过能量函数进行后门攻击检测和表示净化，无需标签、攻击模式或训练数据，在多种SSL编码器和10余种攻击上取得显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督预训练模型易于受到后门攻击，现有防御方法在完全黑盒场景下常常需要标签、攻击模式或训练数据，存在局限性。

Method: 受柏拉图表示假说启发，利用多个独立训练的编码器对同一现实投影的一致性，定义基于源表示与参考表示集的条件能量函数，通过噪声对比估计进行检测训练，通过去噪分数匹配进行表示净化。

Result: 在多种自监督编码器和超过10种攻击上验证了有效性，方法同时支持后门检测和表示净化，在多类攻击下均取得显著性能提升。

Conclusion: 提出的防御范式攻击无关、模型无关、模态无关，且能在完全黑盒测试时部署，为自监督学习的安全防御提供了新思路。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) pretrained models have become a dominant paradigm for visual representation learning, but they are vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Existing defenses struggle to defend against such attacks in a fully black-box setting because they often require access to labels, attack patterns, or training data. To tackle this issue, we propose a new attack-agnostic, model-agnostic, and modality-agnostic black-box test-time defense paradigm, called \emph{Platonic Representation Defense}. It is inspired by the Platonic Representation Hypothesis, which suggests that large-scale independently trained encoders converge toward compatible projections of the same underlying reality. We formalize this idea as a conditional energy function defined over source representations and a set of reference representations. The energy function is trained for detection through noise-contrastive estimation and for representation purification through denoising score matching. Theoretically, the energy gap between matched and mismatched samples is lower bounded by the mutual information between source and reference representations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on multiple self-supervised encoders and more than 10 attacks. The method can perform both representation detection and purification, and achieves substantial performance gains across multiple attacks. Code is available \href{https://github.com/jsrdcht/Platonic-Representation-Defense}{here}.

</details>


### [125] [Resonant Brane Splatting for Arbitrary-Scale Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29453)
*Giulio Federico,Giuseppe Amato,Claudio Gennaro,Fabio Carrara,Marco Di Benedetto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Resonant Brane Splatting (RBS)，一种前馈任意尺度超分辨率框架。RBS用Brane（含高斯-埃尔米特内部模态的基元）替代传统高斯基元，以更少的重叠基元高效建模边缘和纹理，并引入基于量子转折点的精确剔除策略加速光栅化，在速度和质量上均超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于2D高斯泼溅的任意尺度超分辨率方法中，标准高斯是平滑低通基元，建模边缘和精细纹理需要大量重叠且对齐良好的高斯，导致光栅化出现严重瓶颈。

Method: 提出Brane基元，在标准高斯包络上增加内部高斯-埃尔米特模态，每个模态分配独立颜色系数；零阶模态恢复标准高斯，高阶模态捕获高频信息。同时引入基于量子转折点的精确剔除策略，跳过可忽略区域，实现高效可微分光栅化。

Result: 在标准ASR基准上，RBS在重建质量上优于隐式解码器和高斯泼溅基线，并在速度-质量权衡上超越先前高斯泼溅方法。

Conclusion: RBS通过更富表达力的Brane基元和高效剔除策略，以更少基元实现高质量任意尺度超分辨率，取得了更优的速度-质量平衡。

Abstract: Arbitrary-Scale Super-Resolution (ASR) reconstructs images at continuous magnification factors. Recent methods accelerate inference by replacing computationally heavy implicit neural decoders with explicit 2D Gaussian Splatting (GS). However, since standard Gaussians are smooth low-pass primitives, modeling edges and fine textures requires multiple overlapping, well-aligned splats, which creates severe bottlenecks during rasterization. To address this, we introduce Resonant Brane Splatting (RBS), a feed-forward ASR framework. RBS replaces flat Gaussians with Branes: expressive primitives that emit spatially varying colors to natively model local contrast and complex textures within a single footprint. We achieve this by augmenting the standard Gaussian envelope with internal Gaussian-Hermite modes, assigning a distinct color coefficient to each. The zero-order mode recovers standard GS, while higher-order modes capture high frequencies. We predict Brane parameters directly from low-resolution features. Because Branes provide a mathematically richer formulation than simple Gaussians, far fewer primitives need to overlap to reconstruct a given target pixel. To exploit this, we introduce an efficient fully differentiable rasterizer with a precise culling strategy based on the classical quantum turning point. This allows us to safely skip negligible regions, drastically reducing the rendering overhead. Experiments on standard ASR benchmarks show that RBS improves reconstruction quality over implicit and GS baselines, while achieving superior speed-quality trade-off than prior GS methods.

</details>


### [126] [From Phase to Phenomenon: Self-Supervised Learning of Subsurface Scattering with Minimal Phase-shift Inputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29461)
*Arjun Majumdar,Raphael Braun,Andreas Engelhardt,Hendrik PA. Lensch*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种自监督预训练框架，仅用每视角8张高频相移轮廓测量图像即可学习次表面散射光传输表示，通过定制数据增强和专用损失函数，在远少于先前方法所需图像的情况下实现了高保真重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统SSS光传输重建需要大量输入图像，效率低下，且缺乏可泛化的表示学习方法。本文希望以极少的图像输入，通过自监督预训练学习可迁移的SSS表示。

Method: 1) 使用立体投影-相机系统，每视角仅采集8张高频PSP图像；2) 提出针对PSP数据的专用数据增强策略（优于ImageNet风格增强）；3) 设计专用损失函数优化密集散射足迹响应重建，尤其改善各向异性足迹的精度。

Result: 1) 预训练编码器可泛化到未见过的复杂几何和材质物体；2) 在下游任务（空间变化重光照、kNN分类器评估）中有效迁移；3) 相比先前方法，所需图像数量减少数个数量级。

Conclusion: 证明了通过精心设计的自监督学习框架和针对性的数据增强，可以用极少的输入图像学习到高质量的、可泛化的次表面散射光传输表示，大幅降低了数据采集成本。

Abstract: We propose a self-supervised pretraining framework for learning sub-surface scattering (SSS) light transport representations from minimal input. Our method leverages a stereo projector-camera setup that captures only eight high-frequency phase-shift profilometry (PSP) images per view to pretrain an encoder in a multi-view, multi-object setting. We introduce a tailored augmentation strategy for PSP-based SSS data, and show that it significantly outperforms standard ImageNet-style augmentations for SSL pretraining. The pretrained encoder learns generalizable SSS representations that transfer effectively to downstream tasks, including spatially varying relighting and representation evaluation using a kNN classifier. Combined with a decoder, the model reconstructs dense scattering footprint responses, trained using a dedicated cost function that improves accuracy, particularly for anisotropic footprints. Despite using only eight input images per view, our approach generalizes to unseen objects with complex geometry and material properties, achieving high-fidelity reconstructions while requiring orders of magnitude fewer images than prior methods.

</details>


### [127] [MIRROR: Aligning Semantic Relations from Language to Image via Gromov--Wasserstein](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29462)
*Hong-Han Wang,Yuntao Wang,Hu Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MIRROR通过提出半逆Gromov-Wasserstein (SI-GW)几何正则化框架，将语言中的关系先验迁移到视觉表示中，解决了多模态大模型在视觉上下文中无法保持概念间关系一致性的问题，无需额外参数且不增加推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLMs）从语言骨干中继承了丰富的关系先验，但在视觉上下文中应用这些关系时常常失败。现有基于投影的对齐方法只关注每个视觉token携带正确的语义，但从未检查概念之间的关系能否从语言领域成功跨越到视觉领域。

Method: 提出MIRROR框架，核心是半逆Gromov-Wasserstein (SI-GW)问题，这是一个逆几何问题，通过将视觉表示与语言派生的关系先验对齐来迁移关系知识。该公式具有唯一的闭式解，能高效计算。在解码器-only Transformer中应用时，设计了层、头、token三个级别的针对性策略，无需额外参数或推理开销。

Result: MIRROR在提升关系一致性的同时，保持了通用视觉-语言任务的性能。

Conclusion: 通过几何正则化方法有效弥合了语言与视觉之间的关系鸿沟，证明了利用语言结构先验来指导视觉表示学习的可行性，且方法高效实用。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) inherit rich relational priors from their language backbones, yet often fail when asked to apply these relationships in visual contexts. We trace this failure to a structural blind spot: projection-based alignment trains each visual token to carry the right semantics, but never asks whether the relationships between concepts survive the crossing from language to vision. To address this, we propose MIRROR (Mapping Inter-concept Relations from language to visual Representation via Optimal-transport-based Regularization), a geometric regularization framework that transfers relational priors from language to vision by exploiting the rich relational structure encoded in language representations. Specifically, we derive a surrogate loss from the proposed Semi-Inverse Gromov-Wasserstein (SI-GW) problem, an inverse geometric problem that aligns visual representations with language-derived relational priors. We show that this formulation admits a unique closed-form solution that prescribes the ideal visual relational structure implied by language geometry and cross-modal coupling. The structure of the formulation also enables efficient computation, making it applicable to long token sequences. Applying SI-GW inside decoder-only Transformers requires careful design. We introduce targeted strategies at the layer, head, and token levels to ensure stable extraction without additional parameters or inference cost. MIRROR improves relational consistency while preserving performance on general vision-language tasks.

</details>


### [128] [CellDETR: A Detection-Guided Framework for Scalable Cell Representation Learning from Histopathology Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29463)
*Shikang Zhang,Guojun Li,Yicong Mao,Chulin Sha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CellDETR是一种基于Deformable DETR的检测引导框架，通过位置特征解耦和框约束注意力机制，实现从全切片图像（WSIs）中可扩展的细胞级表示学习，在监督分类、无监督预训练和跨数据集迁移任务中均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有病理基础模型在补丁级和切片级表示学习上取得了显著进展，但细胞级表示学习仍未被充分探索，限制了细胞分辨的可解释性、生物学发现和临床转化能力。

Method: 基于Deformable DETR构建检测引导框架，引入位置特征解耦（location feature decoupling）和框约束注意力机制（box-constrained attention mechanism），并结合对比学习设计实现无标签数据上的可扩展细胞表示学习。

Result: 在PanNuke数据集上的监督细胞分类任务中优于现有SOTA方法；通过对比学习预训练提升了下游细胞分类性能；利用Xenium空间转录组学注释预训练后，实现了准确的跨数据集细胞分类。

Conclusion: CellDETR提供了一条可扩展的路径，通向通用的细胞级表示学习框架，推动可解释的计算病理学发展。

Abstract: Recent advances in pathology foundation models have substantially improved patch and slide level representation learning from whole-slide images (WSIs).However, cell-level representations learning remain underexplored, limiting cell resolved interpretability, biological discovery, and clinical translation. We propose CellDETR, a detection-guided framework built on Deformable DETR for scalable cell representation learning from WSIs. By introducing location feature decoupling and box-constrained attention mechanism, CellDETR enables automated extraction of cell-level embeddings, and outperform existing state-of-the-art methods in supervised cell classification on PanNuke data. In addition, by incorporating contrastive learning design, we build a CellDETR-based pretraining model for scalable cell representation learning from unlabeled WSIs, which improves downstream cell classification performance. Furthermore, we show that after pretraining with Xenium spatial transcriptomics-derived cell annotations, CellDETR achieves accurate cross-dataset cell classification, demonstrating the transferability and biological relevance of the learned cell embeddings. Together, CellDETR provides a scalable route toward general cell-level representation learning framework for interpretable computational patholog

</details>


### [129] [Rank-Aware Hyperbolic Alignment for Vision-Language Dataset Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29464)
*Jongoh Jeong,Sun-Kyung Lee,Kuk-Jin Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RAHA方法，在双曲空间中通过分级几何与显式对齐容量控制进行视觉-语言数据集蒸馏，解决低秩对齐限制问题，在固定预算下提升跨模态检索与迁移鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLDD方法在欧氏嵌入空间中强制全维度对齐过于严格，因图像-文本相关性存在秩亏问题（共享语义集中在低维范围，残差子空间弱相关），LoRS虽用低秩分解放松对齐但未显式控制表征空间中的主导对齐容量与结构。

Method: 提出秩感知双曲对齐（RAHA）：1）将多模态表征提升到双曲空间；2）采用非对称目标优化蒸馏对：在共享范围内强制测地线对齐，同时对残差子空间进行正则化以保留模态私有多样性并提升迁移鲁棒性。

Result: 在基准测试中，RAHA在固定预算下展现出具有竞争力的跨模态检索性能以及改进的迁移指标。

Conclusion: 通过双曲空间的分级几何与显式对齐容量控制，RAHA有效缓解了传统VLDD方法中过度对齐的问题，在保留模态私有信息的同时提升了蒸馏效率和模型迁移能力。

Abstract: Vision-language dataset distillation (VLDD) compresses a large image-text paired dataset into a small set of synthetic pairs that can efficiently train contrastive vision-language models under strict data and compute budgets. Most existing methods match expert trajectories or cross-modal statistics, yet still enforce full-dimensional alignment in a Euclidean embedding space. This is often overly restrictive due to rank-deficient image--text correlation, with shared semantics concentrated in a low-dimensional range and remaining variation spread across a weakly correlated residual subspace. LoRS relaxes alignment at the similarity level by low-rank factorization, but does not explicitly control dominant alignment capacity and structure in the representation space. We thus propose a rank-aware hyperbolic alignment (RAHA) that combines hierarchical geometry with explicit alignment-capacity control. RAHA lifts multimodal representations to hyperbolic space and optimizes distilled pairs with asymmetric objectives that enforce geodesic alignment in the shared range while regularizing the residual subspace to preserve modality-private diversity and improve transfer robustness. Experiments on benchmarks show that RAHA demonstrates competitive cross-modal retrieval and improved transfer indicators under fixed budgets.

</details>


### [130] [MAVIN: Multi-Shot Audio-Visual Generation with Narrative Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29473)
*Kaiqi Liu,Yunyao Mao,Ziqi Cai,Zheng Geng,Jing Wang,Qiulin Wang,Xintao Wang,Pengfei Wan,Kun Gai,Shuchen Weng,Boxin Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MAVIN是首个支持多镜头音视频生成与叙事控制的框架，通过边界感知注意力、身份感知传播和多智能体脚本生成，解决了时间错位、可控性差和脚本不完整的问题，在多项指标上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成模型虽能生成高质量视频，但在多镜头音视频叙事中缺乏连贯性，存在时间错位、控制力不足、脚本不完整等问题，无法满足专业影视制作需求。

Method: 1) 边界感知注意力（利用层级化字幕和边界感知token路由实现音视频元素在时间边界内对齐）；2) 身份感知传播（通过身份嵌入和身份感知掩码绑定特定身份的视觉外观和音色）；3) 多智能体脚本生成流水线（将自由文本转化为层级化字幕）；4) 构建MAVINSet多镜头音视频数据集。

Result: 大量实验表明MAVIN达到了SOTA性能，为生成模型融入专业影视制作开辟了新途径。

Conclusion: MAVIN是首个实现多镜头音视频生成与定制化叙事控制的框架，有效解决了多镜头场景下的时间对齐、身份一致性和脚本完整性等关键挑战。

Abstract: While recent generative models produce high-fidelity videos, they struggle with the complex narrative control required for coherent multi-shot audio-visual generation. Existing methods suffer from temporal misalignment, limited controllability, and incomplete scripting. In this paper, we propose MAVIN, the first framework for multi-shot audio-visual generation with customized narrative control. To resolve temporal misalignment, we propose boundary-aware attention, which leverages hierarchical captions and boundary-aware token routing to render audio-visual elements within their respective temporal boundaries. To improve the controllability for multi-subject scenarios, we propose ID-aware propagation, utilizing identity embeddings and an identity-aware mask to bind specific identities to consistent visual appearances and vocal timbres. To provide comprehensive audio-visual narratives, we present a multi-agent scripting pipeline to transform free-form user inputs into hierarchical captions. Furthermore, we construct MAVINSet, a multi-shot audio-visual dataset for robust training and evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MAVIN achieves state-of-the-art performance, opening up a new avenue for integrating generative models into professional filmmaking workflows.

</details>


### [131] [VCS-SLAM: Geometry-Validated Semantic Evidence Fusion for 3D Gaussian SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29494)
*Raman Jha,Shuaihang Yuan,Yi Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VCS-SLAM提出了一种基于几何验证的语义证据融合框架，通过评估语义观测的几何可靠性（可见性一致性、表面支撑边界证据、射线级冲突不确定性）来抑制遮挡、语义边界模糊和射线几何歧义导致的伪影，显著提升了语义3D Gaussian SLAM的地图一致性和重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语义3D Gaussian SLAM方法对所有2D语义先验采用统一优化权重，但在线建图中这些先验并不完全可靠——遮挡、不支持语义边界和模糊射线几何会向全局高斯地图引入持久性语义伪影。

Method: 提出几何验证的语义证据融合框架VCS-SLAM，通过三个维度评估语义观测的几何可靠性：可见性一致性、表面支撑边界证据、射线级冲突不确定性，并据此构建可靠性感知的目标函数，抑制遮挡语义更新、减少无支撑语义扩散、延迟模糊区域的标签分配。

Result: 在Replica数据集上展示了改进的语义一致性、边界保持和重建质量。在ScanNet数据集上表明在真实RGB-D输入下保持有竞争力的跟踪性能。

Conclusion: 通过几何验证机制显著提升了语义3D Gaussian SLAM在复杂场景下的鲁棒性和地图质量，验证了选择性融合语义证据的有效性。

Abstract: Visual SLAM performance often deteriorates in complex real-world applications. Semantic 3D Gaussian SLAM commonly fuses 2D semantic priors into a persistent 3D map using uniform optimization weights. However, such priors are not equally reliable in online mapping: occlusions, unsupported semantic boundaries, and ambiguous ray geometry can introduce persistent semantic artifacts into the global Gaussian map. We propose VCS-SLAM, a geometry-validated semantic evidence fusion framework for RGB-D 3D Gaussian SLAM. Instead of treating all semantic observations as uniformly valid supervision, VCS-SLAM evaluates their geometric reliability through visibility consistency, surface-supported boundary evidence, and ray-level conflict uncertainty. The resulting reliability-aware objective suppresses occluded semantic updates, reduces unsupported semantic bleeding, and delays premature label assignment in ambiguous regions. Experiments on Replica demonstrate improved semantic consistency, boundary preservation, and reconstruction quality. Results on ScanNet further show that VCS-SLAM maintains competitive tracking performance under real RGB-D inputs

</details>


### [132] [Rectifying Mask via Entropy for Distractor-Free 3DGS in Ambiguous Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29496)
*Wongi Park,Jiyeon Lim,Minjae Lee,Myeongseok Nam,Seongjun Choi,Jungwoo Kim,Soomok Lee,William J. Beksi,SangHyun Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RefineSplat提出了一种基于熵感知的自适应掩码构建框架，通过结合熵和实例掩码有效捕获模糊干扰物，在复杂场景下实现了无干扰物的新视角合成，并在自建Ambiguous wild数据集上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法难以区分与静态场景颜色或语义相似的瞬态干扰物（如行人、车辆等），导致新视角合成质量下降。

Method: 1) 提出熵感知自适应掩码方法，利用熵和实例掩码捕获模糊干扰物；2) 提出熵感知密度控制策略，基于熵感知位置梯度对齐高斯基元。
